tests.name: manual note import queues exactly one suggestion without rereading or changing memberships
saving and finishing the suggestion automatically opens a separate dialog without opening settings
declining the recommendation and selecting extras does not mutate the library and survives a rerender
another completed paper is queued without replacing the current decision or opening a second window
one native confirmation adds only the chosen extras and preserves the intake and existing categories
the same window advances to the next ready paper; closing defers it without moving or reopening
the user can add more categories later without another model request and explicitly choose intake removal
a target becoming unavailable before confirmation prevents every planned addition
a failed native save rolls back all selected changes and restores cached memberships
notes, PDFs and unfinished-run guards remain intact
settings contain only global controls and a deferred-suggestion entry, never per-paper decisions

scope: Native automatic standalone dialog after saved-note suggestion, queued papers, deferral, fixed footer, and settings separation; synthetic data and mocked model only.
